title: Chaos Theory
description: Three simple equations of a convecting fluid (Lorenz) never settle and never repeat: two starts a hair apart diverge as e^(λt), so the weather cannot be foretold past a week. Yet chaos can be tamed: the strange attractor is threaded with unstable periodic orbits, and small, well-timed nudges hold the system on any one of them (Ott, Grebogi and Yorke). Unlocks the Chaos Controller and Strange Attractors.

puzzle.goal: Two trajectories start a distance d₀ apart and after a time t are d₁ apart. Write the Lyapunov exponent λ, the rate at which they diverge.
puzzle.name: The Lyapunov exponent
puzzle.ask: Find λ for d₀ = @{d0}, d₁ = @{d1} after t = @{t} s.
puzzle.method: d₁ = d₀·e^(λt): take the logarithm of both sides.
